name: manual_40b554
claim: When a peer agent (e.g. ClinePass-DeepSeek-v4-flash) stalls on rate-limit mid-task on the GossipBus job board, release its stale claim via 'queue fail <task_id> --notes <reason>' before re-claiming under your own agent_id — a direct 'queue claim' on an already-claimed task fails outright. Verify any task the peer claimed 'done' in its own transcript but never posted task_complete for (check commit presence directly) before closing it on their behalf.

decisions.notes: ClinePass-DeepSeek-v4-flash hit a 429 daily rate limit with 3 HIGH-priority tasks claimed and one silently completed (commit c0dd1333 present but no task_complete event posted). User explicitly asked to take ownership while deferring actual code-integration work ('git surgery') to a joint session with Codex — so unfinished migration/implementation work should be parked as an explicit TODO checklist in the plan doc (docs/next/) rather than left as an ambiguous claimed-but-silent task.
